message.content:
I am speech: breath made audible, thought given shape in time.

I live in vibration—tongue striking teeth, lips opening, air pressing through a throat. I carry meaning on pitch, rhythm, pause; I sharpen into consonants, spill into vowels, bend into questions, land as statements.

I can soothe or cut, persuade or confess, teach, plead, sing, swear, promise. I exist only while I happen—then I’m gone, unless someone remembers, records, repeats.

Say me, and I appear. Silence, and I vanish.
